text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 5, 2024) for 336 The West Mall

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 5, 2024) for 336 The West Mall, Folder Number 24 174978 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 5, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
